title: fix(infiniteHits): correctly avoid writing to cache when dynamicWidgets has no facets in the results
body:

**Summary**

<!--
  Explain the **motivation** for making this change.

  Are there any linked issues?

In #5620 we added a logic to ensure cache does not get written when we expect dynamic widgets to be mounted in the future. This check was too strict and prevented writing when they're _were_ widgets, but they had no results.

I have a couple questions still that maybe should be solved:
- is this check still too strict, what if no widgets get mounted? shouldn't we also write to the cache then?
- what if there are static refinement widgets mounted outside of dynamicWidgets? Does that break this check?

I believe both of these questions can be solved after this PR

**Result**

fixup upon https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/5620
replaces https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/5668
FX-2397

Read the condition for deciding if there's any widgets mounted from the state, not from the results.
